credit_score.disclaimer: Marcus operates as a Director with personal guarantees on business facilities. His score is impacted by personal credit card trade utilization spikes and the late payment following his Q1 ATO BAS obligation.

key_insights.title: Late Credit Card Repayment Post-BAS Drain (2 Nov)
key_insights.summary: Your Westpac Business Card payment was 2 days past due ($8,450 balance) right after a $12,450 ATO tax debit.
key_insights.bureau_explanation: Because business credit cards for proprietary limited entities commonly carry a Director Personal Guarantee, negative repayment history flags register against your personal Equifax consumer file, undermining personal credit standing.

key_insights.title: $14,750 Trade Supplier Stacking on Revolving Credit
key_insights.summary: You are funding 30-day wholesale materials (Rexel, Middy's, NHP) through your personal revolving card limit rather than structured trade finance.
key_insights.bureau_explanation: Sustained card utilisation above 50% lowers your credit rating and signals cash-flow latency to automated bank risk engines.

key_insights.title: Commercial Credit Bureau Inquiry Recorded (29 Oct)
key_insights.summary: A trade credit assessment inquiry from illion was logged for wholesale terms.
key_insights.bureau_explanation: Multiple trade credit inquiries within a short timeframe signal to commercial credit providers that the business may be experiencing liquidity challenges.

key_insights.title: Irregular Commingling & Owner Drawings ($12,500 Total)
key_insights.summary: Variable transfers to personal accounts make personal income verification harder for mortgage underwriters.
key_insights.bureau_explanation: Formalizing regular wage disbursements rather than irregular lump-sum drawings strengthens personal borrowing serviceability assessments under APRA guidelines.
